primary_target: independent complete second-order correction delta_A(P_1/2) for neutral K-40 4P

eligible_benchmark_classes.description: direct experimental or empirical extraction of the complete K-40 correction
independent electronic-structure calculation that does not use the Beloy-Derevianko T1/T2 values and yields the complete K-40 correction
recalculation from the same Beloy-Derevianko electronic inputs

frozen_queries_after_registration: "40 K" eta zeta hyperfine P states
databases: Web of Science or an equivalent citation index if available
selection_rule: Use the first uniquely extractable class A benchmark; otherwise the first uniquely extractable class B benchmark ordered by publication date ascending. Record every candidate and exclusion before extracting a numerical target.
no_benchmark_rule: If no class A or B source exists, publish OPEN_NOVEL_PREDICTION_NO_INDEPENDENT_BENCHMARK and do not substitute K-39, K-41, Rb, Be+, or a same-source reconstruction.
ambiguity_rule: Conflicting eligible sources are all recorded and evaluated without selecting the closest value.
